title: Delivery Claims Policy Manual, Section 7: Making the Customer Whole
content:
**7.1** An approved Delivery Claims claim is made whole by its claim type's default resolution.

**7.2** A reshipment sends the same SKU in the same size, by the claim type's reshipment service at the reshipment shipping fee, on a no-charge order. Where the claim type lets the customer choose a refund, the customer may take a merchandise refund instead; when the item cannot be reshipped, the claim is refunded.

**7.3** A merchandise refund pays the claimed value (net merchandise paid plus tax on the claimed lines, or on the whole order for a parcel-scope claim) to the original tenders, in the order of the Online Orders tender refund priority, within the claim type's refund timing in business days.

**7.4** *Retired clause — no longer in force:* that a merchandise refund also pays the order's shipping fee and surcharge where the claim type refunds the shipping fee with merchandise. This clause no longer governs the delivery charge on any claim; the delivery charge is settled under the current delivery-charge refund rules.

**7.5** *Retired clause — no longer in force:* that a Late Delivery Claim refunds the effective shipping fee and surcharge paid on the order.

**7.6** *Retired clause — no longer in force:* that, when that fee was 0.00 because of an Unlimited plan, a Marlowe Rewards threshold or a code, a Late Delivery Claim gives a Goodwill Credit of the claim type's late-delivery goodwill amount instead.

**7.7** A Goodwill Credit given on a Late Delivery Claim is given within the Goodwill Credit caps of Gift Cards & Store Credit, and when the caps are reached nothing further is owed.

**7.8** Compensation is booked only while the claim is in status approved.

**7.9** A Lost in Transit Claim resolved by refund or reshipment closes the original order as lost in transit.

**7.10** Points earned on compensated merchandise are not reversed.

## Status and booking

| Claim status | Compensation may be booked |
|---|---|
| approved | yes |
| opened, carrier trace, under review, denied, resolved, withdrawn | no |

## Reading notes

- Reshipment and refund are the two ways merchandise is made good; the customer's choice of a refund exists only where the claim type allows it, and an item that cannot be reshipped is refunded.
- *Hypothetical:* a Lost in Transit Claim on which the customer took a merchandise refund is resolved; the original order then closes as lost in transit.
- *Hypothetical:* Marlowe Rewards points earned on a jacket that was later refunded under a Delivery Claims claim stay on the membership.

superseded_clauses: A Late Delivery Claim refunds the effective shipping fee and surcharge paid on the order;
when that fee was 0.00 because of an Unlimited plan, a Marlowe Rewards threshold or a code, it gives a Goodwill Credit of `late_delivery_goodwill_usd` instead,
plus the order's shipping fee and surcharge where `refund_includes_shipping_fee`.
